description: Ask for subtitles in other languages for your film/episode: up to 5 codes from translation_requests.languages in list_film_subtitles, once the original subtitles are ready. The Vidreno team approves each language before it is translated, which can take a few days; one request at a time per video. Only where translation requests are switched on; while translation_requests says coming_soon, every request is refused.

source_revision.description: sourceRevision from list_film_subtitles (automatic): the video the original subtitles were made from
